description: Update the messages stored on this machine for every room (or one room); full: true fetches the whole history so search covers it.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

full.description: Fetch the whole history, back to the start of the room

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_sync
